title: [review] extracted SX1262.cs: oversize length prefix permanently kills reader while socket looks Connected (node silently deaf)
description: P2 (pre-existing, inside reviewed ReaderLoop scope). .extraction/renode-lora-peripherals/peripherals/sx126x/SX1262.cs:801 ReadMessage returns null for len > 1024; ReaderLoop treats null as peer-closed and breaks (:707-709) WITHOUT closing the socket; EnsureConnected sees socket.Connected==true (:629) and never restarts a reader -> TX_DONE/RX_PACKET/RX_TIMEOUT never dispatched again until peripheral reset. One corrupted 4-byte header bricks RX. Fix: treat oversize as protocol fault: log + Disconnect() (forces reconnect + fresh reader) instead of returning null as EOF; same for peer-close path: close the socket before break (:795,801,808).
